title: Close House Race in Washington State Could Matter a Lot
summary:
A tight race for the U.S. House is underway in Washington state's 3rd District. Cities, factories, farms, and coastal towns are all part of it. Who wins could help decide which party leads the House.

Democratic Rep. Marie Gluesenkamp Perez won the seat in 2022. Republican John Braun, a state senator who builds emergency vehicles, wants to take it back. President Trump has won this district three times, but voters sometimes split their ballots.

Both candidates talk about manufacturing, natural resources, and small businesses. Local people worry about tariffs that raise costs, high house prices in Vancouver, and hard times for oyster farms and fishing towns.

Some Democrats are unhappy with Perez over certain votes. Braun has Trump's support but says he disagrees with very broad tariffs. Democrats want Perez to keep the seat. Republicans want Braun to win.
why_it_matters: House members help make laws about jobs and trade that affect towns where kids live.
